current_coloc_gwas.evidence: The scooby paper designed and evaluated the exact native REF/ALT exon-sum readout on fine-mapped OneK1K and GTEx whole-blood eQTLs. MASLD GWAS and project COLOC memberships were not profile-training targets, but overlapping GTEx/eQTL Catalog outcomes and score choices are downstream-demo evidence.

gse244832.evidence: GSE244832 is a liver stellate-cell study and is absent from the exact OneK1K PBMC adaptation source. The inherited Borzoi object predates it.

gse281160.evidence: The source became public after the immutable May 2025 checkpoint and perturbation profiles were not scooby training targets.

gse281364.evidence: The MPRA source became public after the immutable May 2025 checkpoint and is absent from its profile-training corpus.

gse289173.evidence: GSE289173 became public before the May 2025 weight, but the complete cell adaptation source is the unrelated OneK1K PBMC cohort. Neither GSE289173 MASLD labels nor its donor cell-type eQTL/interaction-eQTL outcomes were declared training targets. Confidence is medium because the checkpoint postdates GEO and the exact base-conversion revision is unresolved.

gse296875.evidence: GSE296875 became public after the May 2025 checkpoint. Its liver same-nucleus RNA/ATAC, donor QTL and histopathology fields were not exposed.

resource_atlas_current.evidence: No Resource donor labels, MASLD phenotypes or frozen programs were OneK1K scooby targets. Generic liver functional-genomics tracks are inherited only through Borzoi; the learned cell decoder is PBMC-specific.

interpretation: OneK1K scooby is a blood-domain RNA profile and eQTL comparator. Its project target labels are unexposed, but this does not make its 10-D PBMC scPoli context transferable to liver. Exposure eligibility and input/domain eligibility are separate gates.

rules.cell_embedding: Do not substitute a newly trained latent with the same dimension. Recover the exact scPoli model, feature set and query transform or classify frozen inference as unavailable.
rules.genome_overlap: Cross donor folds with chromosome/LD blocks and a 524288-bp buffer for any local adaptation.
rules.held_donor: The upstream checkpoint used genomic holdouts, not a donor-held outer evaluation. All project embedding and adaptation steps remain inside donor folds.
rules.sealed_rule: No GSE289173 label or QTL outcome may select embeddings, cell contexts, readout spans, calibration or thresholds.

upstream_corpus.cell_context: 10-D scPoli RNA latent with donor and cell-type supervision
upstream_corpus.cell_source: OneK1K PBMC, more than 1 million cells from 982 donors
upstream_corpus.topology: RNA-only cells; donor identities were modeled as scPoli conditions but were not held out for scooby evaluation
